answer-sheet.description: one subject's answers as a bubble grid (letters only, a dash for a declined question)

solution-report.description: hybrid full report: question and options, answer, status, doubt in words, steps, explanation, checks (html only when no PDF renderer)

learning-report.description: study view of one subject (answer, why, steps) written for --view learn

answer-table.description: whole exam, one row per question: subject, printed no., answer, status, doubt, error, score

score-vs-key.description: whole exam checked against the official answers: key, ours, correct/WRONG/declined, status, doubt, flag

score-summary.description: whole exam score: per subject correct/wrong/declined, cost, calls, items not correct, doubt vs outcome

metrics.description: per-run metrics (calls, cost, coverage) of one subject

result-data.description: provenance of a report: plan run id, result sha256, view, engine git

run-log.description: copy of the plan run.log (call lines) kept with the pack
